# Suwenzo

> Suwenzo is clinic software for Sri Lanka that connects the doctor's desk, patient records and dispensary in one system, with WhatsApp reminders so patients return on time.

## Canonical Reference Pages
- [Fact Sheet](https://www.suwenzo.com/facts): Quick verified technical facts, hardware requirements, setup timelines, and system scope.
- [How It Works](https://www.suwenzo.com/how-it-works): End-to-end outpatient workflow from doctor tablet prescription to label printing, stock deduction, and WhatsApp reminder.
- [FAQ](https://www.suwenzo.com/faq): Answers to questions asked by Sri Lankan doctors regarding hardware, internet resilience, and consent.
- [About Suwenzo](https://www.suwenzo.com/about): The background story of why Suwenzo was built in Colombo for outpatient practices.
- [Contact Team](https://www.suwenzo.com/contact): Demo scheduling and WhatsApp messaging details.
- [Clinical Practice Blog](https://www.suwenzo.com/blog): Operations and management guides for private clinics in Sri Lanka.

## Feature Spokes
- [Patient Records](https://www.suwenzo.com/features/patient-records): Visit histories, diagnoses, allergy warnings, and vital records in one central file.
- [Digital Prescriptions](https://www.suwenzo.com/features/digital-prescriptions): Instant prescription transmission to dispensary screens and automated thermal packet label printing.
- [Stock and Expiry Tracking](https://www.suwenzo.com/features/stock-and-expiry): Shelf inventory visibility while prescribing, automatic stock deduction, and 60-day expiry warnings.
- [WhatsApp Patient Reminders](https://www.suwenzo.com/features/whatsapp-reminders): Consent-based follow-up reminders sent when a patient's medicine course ends.

## Practice Types
- [Solo Doctors](https://www.suwenzo.com/for/solo-doctors): Practice workflow for solo general practitioners running evening sessions.
- [Clinics with Dispensary](https://www.suwenzo.com/for/clinics-with-dispensary): Integrated workflow for practices that dispense medicines on site.
- [Consulting-Only Practices](https://www.suwenzo.com/for/consulting-only-practices): Practice management without medicine stock, generating printed or WhatsApp prescriptions.
- [Multi-Doctor Centres and Branches](https://www.suwenzo.com/for/multi-doctor-practices): Group practice coordination with separate doctor logins and shared dispensary queues.
